payload.title: clustering_centers_on_raw
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook is designed to visualize cluster centers with added geographical features. It utilizes various Python libraries for data manipulation, visualization, and clustering. The notebook connects to a PostgreSQL database to retrieve data, preprocesses it using scaling techniques, and applies clustering algorithms to identify patterns. The outputs include visual representations of cluster centers on geographical maps.
goals: Visualize cluster centers with geographical features

section_blurbs.blurb: The notebook begins by importing necessary libraries for data manipulation and visualization, including matplotlib, numpy, and mpl_toolkits. It sets up configurations for plotting and prepares the environment for further analysis.
section_blurbs.heading: Notebook start

section_blurbs.blurb: This section focuses on visualizing cluster centers with added geographical features. Clustering algorithms are applied to identify patterns, and the results are visualized on geographical maps.
